_capture.provenance: synthetic — declared, never presented as a recording (GOR-245 specs.md § 6.14(2)). No recording exists and none can be made: the only available test citizen reports `entry_count 0` with `recent_entries []` (measured 2026-08-14), and § 4.4 forbids the top-up and pay writes that would create ledger rows. The ledger's populated states are therefore verified against this declared fixture and NOT against a live payload.
_capture.credential: none — no citizen token was obtained or seeded (§ 4.4; security-review.md item 6)
_capture.field_discipline: Rows are shaped against `types.ts:550-562` (`WalletEntry`) only. No invented field. The `meta` block reuses the paged shape B2 established, so the pager is exercised rather than assumed — `total_pages 2` is what makes the B6a ledger's page-1/page-2 toggle testable at all.
_capture.synthetic_values: All reference numbers carry an explicit `-TEST-` infix; no real receipt number, account number, UIN or name appears (§ 7.9 item 4/5).
